lastCommit.message:
Aerial and Aetherkin trait chips no longer leak as raw identifiers

Adjacent finding from the enemy conditional-effect class audit, settled
here: `aerial` and `aetherkin` had no entry in enemyTraits.ts's TRAIT_LABEL,
so any enemy carrying the literal trait fell through describeTrait() to its
raw internal id on the expanded portrait's trait-chip row and plain-text
contract. Both are real, reachable enemies (aerial: Aetherbat, Scrap Drone,
Aetheric Drone; aetherkin: Drowned Aetherkin, Mud-Wracked Aetherkin), not
hypothetical.

Traced both traits to their actual mechanical consumers before writing a
label — neither is decoration:

- `aerial` (enemyIsAerial): dogCanAct() refuses the dog companion against
  it, escapePursuit() gives it +3 to the contested-flee speed check the
  player must beat to escape combat, and it is the exact condition
  weaponEffects.ts's 'aerial' bonus-condition reads for a ranged weapon's
  authored "+Nd6 vs airborne" effect. Classified MEANINGFUL PLAYER-FACING
  TRAIT.
- `aetherkin` (isAetherkin): gates a real reputation swing — killing one
  applies AETHERKIN_KILL_REP (-3) against the factions that revere the
  Aetherkin, while a successful talk-down applies AETHERKIN_SPARE_REP (+2)
  instead. Classified MEANINGFUL PLAYER-FACING TRAIT (a real consequence
  the player can act on, not lore alone).

Both now carry a proper label in TRAIT_LABEL, in the same "Name — what it
does" shape the existing entries use, stating only the facts above — no
invented numbers, no new mechanic. `portraitTraitChips()` was already
correctly filtering only the true internal markers (`profiled`,
`static_power_scaled`); it is untouched, since the defect was the missing
label, not the filter.

Adjacent Mud Monarch acid-interaction question (from the same task):
traced end-to-end and found NOT a defect. "Mud Monarch takes it with the
acid-etched mud-fist wraps, reels, and fights back" is combatProse.ts's
hitProse() — one of four generic flavor lines picked for ANY landed player
hit on ANY enemy — with `weaponPhrase()` naming the PLAYER's own equipped
weapon (Kevin's acid-coated "Mud-fist Wraps", a starter hand weapon),
never Mud Monarch's gear. Mud Monarch (type Aetheric Mutation) does
genuinely resist acid by TYPE_RESISTANCE_MAP, which gates the coating
through a real 15% COATING_RESIST_LAND_CHANCE roll on a resisted type —
but that mechanic does not produce or condition this narration line, so no
narration change was made; inventing a conditional deflection message here
would misrepresent a generic sentence as mechanic-conditioned. No repair
made, no files touched for this half of the task.

Tests: extended enemyTraits.test.ts — reachability proof against the real
roster, label content proofs for both traits (checked against the actual
mechanic facts, not just non-raw), portraitTraitChips passthrough proof
(the filter didn't change), enemyIsAerial/isAetherkin trait-only proof (no
name/type fallback needed), and a no-broadening check that profiled/
static_power_scaled stay filtered and armored/bleeder labels are
unchanged. 32/32 in the extended suite; 56/56 across the three other
directly-affected trait/chip/technique suites (ota1202, ota1527, qol220).
tsc -p tsconfig.ci.json --noEmit clean. eslint clean.

Golem only — HAL stays on its just-completed catch-up state until Kevin
physically accepts this on Golem.
